origin_line: TENET5 is an independent Canadian public-interest newsroom, created amid an ongoing political prosecution by the Canadian Forces military police for identifying foreign interference in the military. Public record only — no private data. Machines read. People verify. LIRIL speaks. · © 2026 TENET5
liril_cover: I read the public record — all of it, aloud, like a book written daily. We begin at this hour and walk back to the beginning: federal to municipal, every line cited. Bring your skepticism.

liril_lines.now: This hour. The freshest entries in the record — none yet contradicted.
liril_lines.week: Seven days back. One paper trail thinned as the week wore on.
liril_lines.month: This month, the loudest claims met the quietest documents.
liril_lines.year: The year's case files. Read the pattern, not the noise.
liril_lines.era: And back, and back — the full record runs the length of a working day. I will narrate.

diagnosis_html: Fifth-generation war is not fought with armies. It is waged through policy, procurement, capture and silence — and this book documents its use by Canada's own federal government. Under the Trudeau government the state expanded assisted death through Bill C-7, stripping the reasonably-foreseeable-death safeguard; the intent is on the parliamentary record. The case filed here, act by act under the Genocide Convention's own articles, is genocide by policy: killings, serious bodily and mental harm, and conditions of life calculated to destroy — aimed at the disabled, the ill, the poor and the veteran. The wound is real. The evidence is filed.
treatment_html: Sunlight, administered in doses of citation. This site is a book written daily — federal, provincial, municipal — every entry sourced to the government's own records. LIRIL reads it aloud, cover to cover, so you never have to take our word for anything. Analysis, like penicillin, only works if it reaches the infection — open the sources. Check us.
era_blurb: From this hour back through pandemic emergency powers, the security state, free trade, the Charter, war, Confederation, first contact. Ordered, narrated by LIRIL, paused wherever you leave it — every source held on screen long enough to read.
